en: Proverbs 23

p.src: 1  When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

en: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
u.src: 1  When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

p.src: 2  put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

en: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.
u.src: 2  put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

p.src: 3  Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

en: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
u.src: 3  Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

p.src: 4  Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

en: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
u.src: 4  Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

p.src: 5  Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

en: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
u.src: 5  Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

p.src: 6  Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

en: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,
u.src: 6  Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

p.src: 7  for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

en: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
u.src: 7  for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

p.src: 8  You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

en: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
u.src: 8  You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

p.src: 9  Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

en: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
u.src: 9  Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

p.src: 10  Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

en: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
u.src: 10  Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

p.src: 11  for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

en: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
u.src: 11  for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

p.src: 12  Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

en: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
u.src: 12  Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

p.src: 13  Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

en: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
u.src: 13  Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

p.src: 14  Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

en: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
u.src: 14  Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

en: 23:14 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 15  My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

en: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
u.src: 15  My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

p.src: 16  Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

en: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
u.src: 16  Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

p.src: 17  Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.

en: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.
u.src: 17  Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.

p.src: 18  Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

en: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
u.src: 18  Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

p.src: 19  Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

en: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
u.src: 19  Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

p.src: 20  Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

en: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;
u.src: 20  Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

p.src: 21  for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

en: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
u.src: 21  for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

p.src: 22  Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

en: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
u.src: 22  Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

p.src: 23  Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

en: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
u.src: 23  Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

p.src: 24  The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

en: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.
u.src: 24  The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

p.src: 25  Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

en: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
u.src: 25  Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

p.src: 26  My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

en: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
u.src: 26  My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

p.src: 27  For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

en: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
u.src: 27  For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

p.src: 28  Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

en: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.
u.src: 28  Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

p.src: 29  Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

en: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
u.src: 29  Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

p.src: 30  Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

en: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
u.src: 30  Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

p.src: 31  Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

en: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
u.src: 31  Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

p.src: 32  In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

en: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
u.src: 32  In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

p.src: 33  Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

en: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
u.src: 33  Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

p.src: 34  Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

en: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
u.src: 34  Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

p.src: 35  “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”

en: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”
u.src: 35  “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”
